buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder to comply with the following conditions :- 1. Bidder to provide delivery of the stores/ spares at specified locations within the delivery period. Locations are subject to minor changes (upto 50km). Bidder will not have any representati on whatsoever in this regard. 2. The item (in partial or whole) is liable to be rejected if not found conforming to requisite qu ality and specs. 3. Payment of GST/ any Govt dues will be the sole responsibility of the bidder. Confirmation w ith regard to the same is mandatory. 4. Payment schedule - The payment will only be made on basis of receipt and acceptance of 100% stores by the Board of officers as per specification and as per terms and conditions of contr act. 5. The spares/ items should be conforming to specification/relevant IS and ISI marked. The sp ares (in partial or whole) is liable to be rejected if not found conforming to requisite quality and sp ecs.

6. Bidder to replace the defective/ unsuitable spares/ parts within 7 days of raising request fo r the same from buyer. 7. Bidder shall provide warranty against manufacturing defects for a period of 12 months fro m the date of supply. 8. Sample must be provided by the successful bidder within 7 days of award of contract. The bidder has to submit pre bid meeting report (Mandatory). 9. Bidder should have experience of successful supply and delivery of stores similar product f or last three consecutive financial years to any defence establishment in remote area. 10. The timely supply of spares by the supplier as per the supply order is of paramount impor tance. Hence, no time extension of any kind shall be granted under any circumstances (except un der force majeure i.e due to critical situation). The supply order is liable to be cancelled in case of non-supply of stores within completion period. No litigation or arbitration under any circumstances at any stage shall be applicable. The decision of Commanding Officer shall be final and binding in all matters. 11. Each and every item should adhere to latest ISI specification, relevant IS, OEM. Any specifi c brand or make (not specified above) may be accepted subject to approval from any defence esta blishment. 12. Only relevant documents be uploaded as per the criteria mentioned. Uploading of irreleva nt and (or) incorrect information/ documents may lead to rejection of technical bid. No representat ion whatsoever will be entertained thereafter. 13. Copy of EMD to be uploaded online and original to be submitted offline before opening of technical bid. Non receipt of original EMD before technical bid opening date will be technically disq ualified. 14. Performance of bidder in command and with any Govt/ PSUs department shall be assesse d during evaluation. Bidder to upload the latest work load return (WLR) for evaluation. Non-perfor mance in any of the formation/ organization can lead to rejection of bid. 15. Bidder to provide any accessories/ tools/ equipment which deems to be necessary as per buyer discretion for site modification/ joining/ fabricating without any extra cost to Govt. 16. In case of any ambiguity with respect to understanding/ interpretation of technical specificatio n/ store list/ drawings etc, decision of buyer will be final and binding.

17. Bidder must submit product catalogue/ data sheet for each product. 18. A self declaration on firm’s letter head to be attached regarding that the have completely understand all term & condition in the bid & their acceptance to be BOQ/ product compliance alon g with the supporting documents. 19. Non black listed certificate from any Govt/ PSU uploaded on GeM portal, upload the same on Notarized stamps paper Rs 100/-. Signature on stamp paper should not be earlier more than si x months. 20. Bidder must be OEM authority letter & sample of product after Bid. 21. A copy of valid enlistment letter as a supplier in appreciate category on auth. 22. MII certificate & bidder must be MSME verified. 23. Demurrage Charges. In case the rejected items are not picked up by the firm within 48 hrs, the demurrage charges at the rate of 0.5% of total contract value will be charged per day. In c ase the items are not picked up within a month, the same will be destroyed by the station board of officers and no claim will be admitted. 24. Inspection of stores as below:- (a) Pre dispatch inspection will be completed by successful bidder and Inspection re port with respect to the same will be forwarded to buyer within one week of inspection. (b) The buyer has a right to inspect goods in reasonable manner and within reasonabl e time at any reasonable place as indicated in contract. (c) An independent inspection will be carried out by independent Board of Officers of buyer organization. (d) Board of Officers shall have the right to put all the stores or materials forming part of the same or any part thereof to such tests as he may like fit and proper as per governi ng specification. The seller shall not be entitled to object on any ground whatsoever to the method of testing adopted by the inspecting officer. (e) Unless otherwise provided for in the contract, the quantity of the stores or materi

al expended in test will be borne by seller (f) Inspecting officer is the final authority to certify performance/ accept the consignm ent. The inspecting officer’s decision as regards the rejection shall be final and binding on the selle r. 25. Official Secret Act. The contractors attention is invited to Indian Official Secret Act 1923 (x xx of 192 3) particularly Sec 5 of thereof. The contractors shall be bound by the provision of this A ct. 26. High tech items to adhere to MII percentage as per govt norms. 27. Items for which no QC codal provn exists to be proc after prior apvl of buyer. Non apvl will lead to rejection and no further representation. 28. Contractor to submit working drawing or user manual for all sup only contracts. 29. Confirmation to the above conditions is mandatory during the Tech evaluation. 30. Department holds the right to accept or reject the bid wholly or partially without assigning any reason upload an undertaking. 31. Local office should be at Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh & Delhi. . 4. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 5. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 6. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the

OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 9. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 10. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 11. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c.
